==Image Categories==
Just an explanation of how the files are structured - when you upload images, you should add the category "Images by ForagingSpoons" to each page. I will be doing a lot of work tidying up the exising image categories and adding artists' galleries and external links. The category page for each artist in turn belongs to the Images by artist category. We will also be labelling the AI ones as "Image by ForagingSpoons using MidJourney" or replacing MidJourney with whatever you used.

Many thanks,
[[User:Moridin 2000|Moridin_2000]] ([[User talk:Moridin 2000|talk]]) 21:05, 24 August 2023 (UTC)

Thanks for the explanation! As a 1st time reader of the Wheel of Time series, I was curious about the visuals (so many characters!). Since there weren't updated visuals for lots of the characters, I was excited to try adding via AI images. But, I hadn't thought much about keepings things consistent, organized, and accurate. I was mainly thinking to create something where little existed. Please let me know how I can help and excuse slow responses! Eventually I come around to seeing these! [[User:ForagingSpoons|ForagingSpoons]] ([[User talk:ForagingSpoons|talk]]) 19:38, 28 August 2023 (UTC)
